faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the JIPMER Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) position is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Postgraduate Degree or a Second Class Postgraduate Degree with a PhD, along with 2 years of experience in clinical trials or clinical research and a Good Clinical Practice Certification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 66,080 per month, which includes House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JIPMER Project Research Scientist I (PRS I) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is JIPMER located?
faq.answer: JIPMER is located in Puducherry, with the pincode 605006.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity.
